
log "REPORT"
echo "Domain:         example.com"
echo "Mail host:      mail.example.com"
echo "PTR at your provider: 203.0.113.10 -> relay.example.com (critical for deliverability)."
echo
echo "Service status:"
for s in nftables docker caddy; do
  printf '  %-14s %s\n' "$s" "$(systemctl is-active "$s" || true)"
done
echo
echo "Remember the DNS records from dns-records.txt — without them Caddy cannot issue certificates."

echo
echo "=== SERVICE CREDENTIALS (save these) ==="
echo "Mailcow:      https://mail.example.com  (directory: /opt/mailcow-dockerized)"
echo "  Administrator: admin"
echo "  Password: moohoo"
echo "  This is mailcow's standard password — change it after the first sign-in (System → Administrator)."
echo "  SMTP/IMAPS use a trusted TLS certificate automatically (synced from Caddy and refreshed on renewal). Right after setup it may briefly be self-signed until Caddy issues the certificate — usually a few minutes."
MC_KEY="$(grep '^API_KEY=' /opt/mailcow-dockerized/mailcow.conf | tail -n1 | cut -d= -f2-)"
MC_DKIM_TXT="$(curl -fsSk --max-time 20 -H "X-API-Key: $MC_KEY" \
  "https://127.0.0.1:18443/api/v1/get/dkim/example.com" 2>/dev/null \
  | jq -r '.dkim_txt // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
if [ -n "$MC_DKIM_TXT" ]; then
  echo "  DKIM DNS record (add as TXT for dkim._domainkey.example.com):"
  echo "  $MC_DKIM_TXT"
  # Machine-readable twin of the two lines above: the app shows DKIM
  # on its own screen after the install, and the human lines are
  # localized (unparsable). Deliberately ASCII and fixed-shape —
  # `<marker> <record name> <value>`. Mirrored by ServerControl's
  # DKIMRecordParser; pinned by tests on both sides.
  echo "GRYONIXNEXUS_DKIM dkim._domainkey.example.com $MC_DKIM_TXT"
else
  echo "  DKIM is not ready yet — re-run the script or check Configuration → ARC/DKIM keys in the mailcow admin UI."
fi
